The '''Baradium Processing Facility''' was a facility on [[Denova]] that processed [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] ore. During the [[Battle of Denova]] it was overtaken by [[Kephess]] and his [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], who turned the facility for their own use.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baradium Processing Facility appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation.<ref name="SWTOR" />
